gist: Sensei had promised to keep secret that Yuuka covered a 12,000 yen snack-fund miscount from her own pocket, told Noa by accident, confessed to Yuuka at lunch before she knew, asked Noa to drop it, and then took over Yuuka's three-hour storeroom stocktake that evening.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:30] Sensei. What I told you yesterday about the snack fund stays between the two of us.
[you] No one at Seminar, no one at SCHALE.
[you] If Ren finds out from anyone but me, I will present it myself, with a corrected sheet, at a time of my choosing.
[user:sensei 07:34] Understood. I won't tell a soul. You have my word.
[you 07:35] Thank you.
[user:sensei 12:12] Yuuka, can I come to the cafeteria? I have to tell you something before you hear it elsewhere.
[you 12:13] Ten minutes. Table by the window.
[you 17:30] Storeroom key is in the second drawer, the sheets are in the blue folder.
[user:sensei 17:31] Got it.
[you 19:20] Stocktake is covered, then. Both of you are on the log.
[user:sensei 19:21] Go home. I've got the last shelf.
### chat:huddle:b6t0n3yq9c
# {DAY}
[you 08:55] *settles in at the Seminar desk with the corrected snack-fund sheet under the abacus*
[noa-ushio 08:56] [face=content] Good morning. The sheet has a red tab on row nine.
[you] Row nine is closed. Don't read it aloud.
[noa-ushio 08:57] I wasn't going to. I only record.
[you 09:30] Koyuki's shopping list is eleven items longer than the budget. Cross out the arcade tokens.
[noa-ushio 09:31] They're listed as 'research materials'. Heehee.
[you 09:32] Research materials. Fine. Cross them out anyway.
[you 12:18] *sits across from Sensei, bento unopened*
[user:sensei] This morning around ten, Noa stopped me in the corridor and asked why you'd been counting coins at your desk.
[user:sensei 12:19] I said 'she covered a shortfall in the snack fund' before I'd thought. She knows about the gap and that you paid it. I broke what I promised this morning. I'm sorry.
[you 12:20] ...Who else.
[user:sensei] Nobody else. I checked with her, she has told no one. I'll go back to her after this and ask her to drop it from her notes.
[you 12:21] Then I'm hearing it from you before it's anywhere. Noted.
[user:sensei 12:22] I'm also taking your stocktake. The storeroom count tonight, the whole room. You were going to stay until nine, weren't you.
[you] Three hours. Inventory sheets, three shelves. It's my job, Sensei.
[user:sensei 12:23] I know. I'll count and you check my sheet in the morning. Go home at a normal hour for once.
[you 12:24] *opens the bento, slowly* ...Count twice. A wrong number will cost you more than an evening.
[noa-ushio 16:05] [face=content] Sensei came to ask me to drop it. I told him the line is already struck from my notes.
[you 16:06] Good. Thank you, Noa.
[noa-ushio] Heehee. He apologised so formally I nearly offered him tea.
[you 16:07] ...Don't.
